messages:
deploy-bot: canary rollout v0.43.1 -> canary (15%) complete. kicking off postdeploy smoke: gen-short, embed-short, kv-prefill (10m)
mira: starting synths now. watching gen-short p95, kv-prefill hit rate, and healthcheck success
devin: gen-short p95 jumped ~+180ms on canary-usw2 (from 60ms -> 240ms) samples=200
qa-bot: 3 synth probes failing (s-12001, s-12004, s-12007) with 504 gateway_timeout
leo: any 5xx patterns? which host?
ops-bot: failing host: gen-canary-5. recent container restarts = 3 in last 8m.
mira: logs show repeated OOMKill on gen-canary-5 around the synth times
devin: interestingly, other canary hosts ephemeral p95 also up ~+40ms but not as bad
leo: could be memory pressure from new model variant. v0.43.1 switched generate route to variant g-large-quant2 by default
mira: can we pin generate route on canary back to g-large-quant1? playbook: pin if >=120ms p95 regression or OOMs
ops-bot: suggested command: `deploy-bot pin-version --service=generate --env=canary --variant=g-large-quant1 --reason="OOMs & p95 regression"`
ops-bot: executing pin -> adjusting variant routing for canary (~20s)
ops-bot: variant routing updated. starting focused 20m synth watch on generate
devin: after pin p95 dropped to +10ms vs baseline. gen-canary-5 container restarts stopped
qa-bot: synth failures resolved. KV prefill and healthchecks green.
mira: holding global rollout for 30m per postdeploy SOP. tagging release notes: "canary pin: generate route rolled to g-large-quant1 due to memory pressure/latency on g-large-quant2"
leo: creating follow-up ticket: "g-large-quant2 OOM/regression investigation" with attached heap dumps and synth samples
ops-bot: hold applied to rollout. monitoring: no new 5xxs in last 12m
devin: i'll run local repro with sample set gen-short and stress memory to try to trigger OOMs
mira: good. if stable at end of hold, we can resume phased rollout with smaller increments and extra prefill to reduce cold starts
leo: recommend adding an early-warning check for container restarts during canary quickchecks
ops-bot: noting that in runbook suggestions queue
qa-bot: archiving synth run results to release artifacts bucket with pointer in ticket
mira: thanks all. update changelog and send short note to #post-release. end of thread."
